description: The TileLang router and BF16 projection tests of vLLM patches 0032-0034, from the candidate image's own vLLM tree: TileKernels routing like DeepSeek's reference; the fused gate router bit-identical to the gate followed by TileKernels' router at 1-64 rows (target and drafter, image tokens included) and falling back to the gate GEMM above; every split-K row tile height bit-identical to the full batch.
